== Summary ==
A game at Zu Den Vier Winden in Bochum during the [[2015 European Championship]], 17 October 2015. The poster's caption: "Light Side Senate against Dark Villains". The players are not named.

* '''Event:''' [[2015 European Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2015-10-27
